items.limitation: Platform codec APIs can report support that fails for real samples.
items.workaround: Run the Duskcue capability wizard and update the device profile before allowing direct play for advanced codecs.

items.limitation: Cleartext HTTP is acceptable only for local/VPN mode.
items.workaround: Gate exposed-mode server origins behind HTTPS and OS-trusted certificates.

items.limitation: Simulator cannot prove hardware codec, HDR, or audio route behavior.
items.workaround: Require physical iPhone smoke for playback release claims.
items.fallback: Treat simulator as navigation/auth evidence only

items.limitation: HEVC, Dolby, and some HDR paths depend on optional extensions, GPU, and display chain.
items.workaround: Record installed codec extensions and GPU driver in evidence.

items.limitation: Intel and Apple silicon Macs expose different decode and power characteristics.
items.workaround: Keep separate device profile evidence for each architecture.
items.fallback: Transcode advanced formats until profile is proven

items.limitation: Media codec availability varies by distro policy and installed packages.
items.workaround: Document runtime packages and smoke a conservative H.264/AAC baseline.

items.limitation: OEM TVs and Google TV dongles can differ for HDR, audio passthrough, and subtitle rendering.
items.workaround: Keep model-specific device profiles and validate on at least one physical TV-class target.
items.fallback: Transcode video/audio or burn-in image subtitles

items.limitation: Fire OS behavior and Appstore requirements diverge from Google Play Android TV.
items.workaround: Run Fire TV-specific ADB install and remote-control smoke.
items.fallback: Use Android TV contract with Fire OS-specific exceptions documented

items.limitation: Codec, container, subtitle, and HDR support vary by Roku model generation.
items.workaround: Capture Roku model and OS version with every playback evidence record.
items.fallback: Transcode or burn in unsupported subtitle formats

items.limitation: Samsung TV Emulator cannot prove AVPlay hardware media behavior.
items.workaround: Require physical or Remote Test Lab media evidence for release.
items.fallback: Keep emulator evidence scoped to UI/auth/navigation

items.limitation: Magic Remote pointer and D-pad focus behavior can diverge.
items.workaround: Run both pointer and D-pad smoke scripts on physical TV.
items.fallback: Prefer deterministic D-pad focus for all critical flows

items.limitation: tvOS simulator cannot prove HDR, Dolby Vision, HDMI audio, or Top Shelf behavior.
items.workaround: Require Apple TV 4K hardware before tvOS release claims.
items.fallback: Treat simulator as layout/auth/focus evidence only

items.limitation: Xbox Series, Xbox One S/X, and original Xbox One have different media capability envelopes.
items.workaround: Make Series S/X release-required and document One-family support separately.
items.fallback: Reduced-capability profile and transcode for older consoles
